name: Browserable
notes: Inspected at commit a3af19a6 (27 August 2025). The README sets up a Docker Compose stack (UI server, tasks server, MongoDB, Redis and MinIO) in which the user supplies one LLM key (Gemini, OpenAI or Claude) and a Steel or Hyperbrowser key; tasks/services/browser.js also accepts Browserbase or the repository's own browser service, which launches Playwright Chromium. In tasks/agents/browserable.js the act-on-tab action calls simpleActionHelper, whose loop takes a plain page screenshot and the current chunk of DOM elements with XPaths, asks a planner for high-level steps (replanning after five steps), and asks a runner for a Playwright method, arguments and element number; the older DOM-only and vision act helpers are commented out at that call site. The repository also contains deep-research and generative agents. The README's 90.4% WebVoyager figure is publisher-reported and was not reproduced. The README names Stagehand among the open-source projects it builds on. No code was run.
summary: Self-hosted browser-agent platform with a JS SDK and REST API: a planner sets high-level steps, and a runner reads a screenshot and a numbered DOM chunk to pick Playwright actions in a local or hosted browser.
